needs_human.note: `_all: true` in a map overrides every feature value in all views, including the settings screens. Only `_all: false` is documented in docs/reference/configuration.md, and the `_all: true` case is pinned only by a fixture row.; Turning an addon on removes any stored `index` key from its map, including a hand-written `index: true`. This does not change the behaviour, because an absent key reads as on.; A hand-written `_all: true` map is reduced by off then on to its bare feature keys, so a feature it had been masking takes effect.
The docs do not specify what `_all: true` in a map means or how the feature switches should behave with it. The code treats it as overriding every feature (config.py:148-149, adminConfig.ts:31).
